title: Time Jump: Overpressure Spreading in Downtown Corwin

fields.narration: It is now 17:30. The overpressure condition in Pressure District 7 has spread. Field crews report sustained overpressure at both RS-21 and RS-22. A resident on Canal Street reports seeing a flash and hearing a boom—though Corwin Fire confirms no explosion. The SCADA system still shows nominal pressure across the network. Field gauges and recorders confirm pressure at 24 in. w.c. and rising. Gas Control remains unaware of the true state. The public is in panic. The shift cannot wait for verification—life safety is at risk.
worldState: . The EOC in Room 140, Level 3, is active and staffed under CVG-EP-2026 and CVG-CIRP-2026. . Field crews report overpressure at RS-21 and RS-22. . PR-7B shows 15.2 in. w.c. and is still rising. . Corwin Fire confirms no explosion but notes a flash and loud noise from a residential area near Canal Street. . The control room continues to show no alarms or SCADA anomalies. . The public is reporting panic and confusion across downtown Corwin, especially near the senior residences and Corwin Area High School. . The IC has confirmed that the EOC is operational and all roles are to proceed with assigned responsibilities.
